## US3 Drop a piece off before the firing
Functionalities: F2
As Ana I want pieces dropped before Friday 6 pm fired that week so that I collect them on time
### Acceptance
- Given a piece dropped off on Friday at 17:59, when the kiln fires, then the piece is in that firing
### First test
Write a test that drops a piece off at 17:59 on Friday and expects it in that week's firing.
